_ohje: Elävä maalaus (VP05): maailmojen taustamaalaukset. Tyylireferenssi on hyväksytty art/backgrounds/hero-island.jpg; hahmoja ei generoida (ne tulevat hyväksytyistä PNG-kuvista). Tärkeä sisältö on kuvan vasemmassa ja oikeassa viidenneksessä, koska keskellä on sovelluksen lukusarake. Raakakuvat menevät git-ignoroituun kansioon tools/imagegen/out/visual-polish/world/, sivutiedostot kopioidaan tools/visual-polish/provenance/. Aja repojuuresta: node tools/imagegen/imagegen.mjs batch tools/visual-polish/batches/world.json [--live] Päivä- ja iltaversio tehdään samasta sommitelmasta: toinen syntyy muokkaamalla hyväksyttyä ensimmäistä (ensimmäinen syötekuva), jotta näyttämöpaikat pysyvät samoina. Aja yksittäinen työ: --only <nimi>.

vars.subject: a wide panoramic view of a calm Finnish lake archipelago on a warm summer evening at dusk, in exactly the same hand-drawn coloured-pencil style, dark blue outline weight and paper grain as the reference image. Sky in the upper 45%: a soft gradient from warm peach and apricot just above the horizon to dusty lavender and then deep evening blue at the very top, with four or five tiny pale first stars near the top corners only. A low golden sun half-set on the horizon just right of the centre, with a long calm shimmering golden reflection path on the water below it. Water fills the lower 55%: calm turquoise water turning lavender-blue towards the horizon, with a few short light wave dashes. LEFT EDGE (only the left fifth of the image, top to bottom): a tall shore with dark green pine trees on pink granite rocks; at the bottom-left a big flat smooth granite rock slab reaching into the water, with three large round green lily pads and one white water lily floating in the shallow water just right of it; tall green reeds and brown cattails along the waterline. RIGHT EDGE (only the right fifth of the image): a small rocky island with a red-and-white wooden lighthouse and a tiny orange pennant flag on its roof, a short grey wooden jetty reaching left into the water at about two thirds of the image height, and four lily pads floating in open water near the bottom-right corner. CENTRE (the middle three fifths): only open calm water and evening sky, with two very small distant low islands on the horizon line and nothing else
vars.space: the middle three fifths of the image

vars.subject: a wide panoramic view of a small calm Finnish forest lake shore on a fresh bright summer morning, in exactly the same hand-drawn coloured-pencil style, dark blue outline weight and paper grain as the reference image. Sky in the upper 45%: clear pale morning blue, lighter and slightly warm near the horizon, with two or three small soft white clouds. A thin soft white morning mist lies low over the far water along the horizon. Water fills the lower 55%: calm turquoise lake water, lighter towards the horizon, with a few short light wave dashes. LEFT EDGE (only the left fifth of the image, top to bottom): white-trunked birch trees and one big spruce on a grassy bank; a small curved light sandy beach at the waterline with a small unfinished raft of four tied wooden logs lying on the sand; one big smooth round grey boulder standing in the shallow water just right of the beach; three large round green lily pads floating in the water at the bottom-left; green reeds along the waterline. RIGHT EDGE (only the right fifth of the image): a grassy bank with a few pine trees and rounded bushes; a short old wooden plank jetty on posts reaching left into the water at about two thirds of the image height, with a small red wooden rowing boat tied to it; three flat stepping stones in the shallow water; four lily pads floating near the bottom-right corner; tall reeds and cattails along the waterline. CENTRE (the middle three fifths): only open calm water and morning sky, with the far wooded shore of the lake as a very low soft blue-green line on the horizon and nothing else

LEFT EDGE (only the left fifth of the image, top to bottom): a small cosy wooden research hut with a green roof and two small square windows, built on stilts over the water at the shore; a brass weather vane and a little cup anemometer on its roof; a short wooden ladder from the hut down to a small floating wooden platform; one tall thin striped red-and-white measuring pole standing in the water (stripes only, no numbers or letters); green reeds along the waterline; three large round lily pads and one flat grey rock in the water at the bottom-left. RIGHT EDGE (only the right fifth of the image): a long low wooden boardwalk running along the shore at about two thirds of the image height, its planks painted with evenly spaced coloured stripe markers like a jumping-contest track (no numbers, no letters); at its end a small wooden stand with a brass telescope on a tripod and a striped orange windsock on a pole; birch trees and rounded bushes behind it; four lily pads floating near the bottom-right corner. CENTRE (the middle three fifths): only open calm pond water and summer sky, with the far shore as a very low soft green line on the horizon and nothing else
